svg.title: Recovering a sphere radius rate from its volume rate
svg.desc: For a sphere, volume is four thirds pi times radius cubed. At radius four centimetres, the derivative of volume with respect to radius is sixty-four pi square centimetres. The forward rate relation is volume rate equals sixty-four pi times radius rate. Given volume rate thirty-two pi cubic centimetres per second, dividing by sixty-four pi gives radius rate one half centimetre per second. The outward diagram runs from radius to volume; the final calculation reverses this relation to recover the unknown radius rate.
